what_it_is.prose: VEM Technologies Pvt Ltd is a Hyderabad-based Indian private-sector aerospace, defence and homeland security systems solutions company founded in 1988 by V. Venkata Raju (Chairman & Managing Director). The company employs over 900-1,200 professionals and has core business verticals in Missiles, Aerostructures, and Space components. VEM Technologies is one of the major production partners of BrahMos Aerospace Pvt Ltd (BAPL) — delivered fully indigenous component of BrahMos weapon system on 2 February 2017. VEM supplies critical systems and components for prominent strategic missile programmes including BrahMos, Akash, and others (per Manufacturing Today India). The company is developing: (1) Ajita — a complete Air Defence System including sensors, mounting vehicle, missiles and their launchers for air defence; (2) Vidhwamsak — indigenous 250 km range missile (per SaveJammu Facebook post); VEM has the licence to develop 10,000 tactical missiles per year (per The Hindu, June 2022). VEM Technologies plans to build company-designed aircraft by 2027 (per MD interview). On 20 May 2026, VEM Technologies secured ₹185 crore growth capital investment from InCred Capital Financial Services.
